research_read_only.sources: repo baseline commit e6fc40b (original working tree, approved files) and current repo files; not the original source folder, not the live installation, not the backup folder, not E:
findings: The everyday JARVIS's Settings has a 'Backup & recovery' section (shown under 'Backups') with the buttons 'Create verified backup' and 'Test restore in temporary folder' (static/recovery.js).

With its default data folder, it saves backups as <id>.zip in the folder beside its program folder named 'jarvis-backups' (server.py line 886 at e6fc40b), i.e. C:\Users\jonny\Documents\Codex\2026-09-07\cr\outputs\jarvis-backups if the everyday JARVIS matches the baseline. The screen shows the folder after each action ('N backup(s). Folder: ...'), so the owner confirms it there.
'Test restore' writes <id>.restore-check.json beside the zip with status restore_rehearsal_passed.

Archive format: zip with manifest.json format 1, data/... and app/... entries, data/jarvis.sqlite3 snapshot, .env excluded. FINAL's switch_over.py reads format 1, imports only data/..., and takes the personality and desktop preferences from app/personality.txt and app/desktop/preferences.json, the same names the old backup uses. Real compatibility is what Gate 18 tests.
